Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Ayaan - 12 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
4. Ananya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
5. Pihu - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi, Ayaan and Ananya stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan whispers something to Mother.]

Rohan (happily): "What next?"

[Rohan trips over a stone and falls.]

Rohan: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Pallavi, Ayaan and Ananya stand near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan reads a storybook.]

Rohan (happily): "And then?"

[Rohan writes in his notebook.]

Rohan (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Rohan studies for his exam.]

Rohan: "Ayaan, are you okay?"

[Rohan does his homework at the table.]

Ayaan (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Rohan watches cartoons on TV.]

Rohan: "What a day to remember!"
